notes.title: Update for V1.11
notes.notes:
Patch to 1.11c
Following feedback from Play Expo 2024 there have been a couple of small changes 

[list]
[*] Turbo walk is not allowed if you have low energy
[*] Grubs are easier to kill 
[*] Terrain slightly less red on level 2
[*] Better targeting of ant entities - plus some smoke and gas from the body
[*] Fix for occasional laser render artifacts
[/list]

notes.title: Update for V1.11
notes.notes:
A very small patch to v1.11b

[list]
[*] Emergency smart laser allows player to use even if energy is low.
[*] Better light flash effect
[*] Bolder route line coloring
[*] More subtle coloring of higher level terrains
[*] Fix to show auto mode in display settings when screen adjustment has to be done at start
[*] Fix for minor glitch in start up sequence
[/list]

notes.title: Play Expo 2024 Discount
notes.notes:
Play Expo Blackpool is the UK's biggest retro games expo and Pixel Fandango will be there.

To promote Hex.Plan.X Pixel Fandango is offering a 25% discount for new players and, if you're in the UK, a chance to meet the developers.

October 5-6th 2024. Norcalympia Exhibition Centre, Blackpool, UK.
https://www.playexpoblackpool.com/

notes.title: Update for V1.11
notes.notes:
V1.11 (a)
[list]
[*] East and West regions made easier in level one to help new players.
[*] Smart laser kills all small enemies but uses a lot of energy.
[*] Killing an ant clears any police record.
[*] Improved start-up menu background images.
[*] Fix for full-screen mode using scaled display modes.
[*] Fix for restart after turbo walk mode.
[*] More compact hint layout and always show warnings even if hints on.
[*] Wall outline changes color with level and terrain color change is more obvious.
[/list]

notes.title: HEX.PLAN.X V1.11
notes.notes:
[b]Game Play[/b]
[list]
[*] Ants drop occasional upgrade tokens when killed
[*] Rescuing enough humans is rewarded with items
[*] Police are more aggressive + More warnings about carrying contraband
[*] Waypoints eject tokens for player to pick up rather than showing upgrade messages
[*] Deposit contraband for items and upgrades as well as points
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] New play start graphics and sound
[*] Better weapon graphics for all entities
[*] Better human rescue graphic and sound
[*] Transmission graphics for enemies
[*] Waypoint highlighting in high detail mode
[*] Reflections in water in high detail mode
[*] Darker water for improved contrast
[*] Central control graphics
[*] Wall border highlight
[/list]

[b]Other Stuff[/b]
[list]
[*] Clearer start sequence and hints
[*] Gamepad button functions available on keyboard (A, Y, B)
[*] Fix for high refresh rate monitors
[*] Better multiple sparks graphics
[*] Some minor map updates including pale mesh webs.
[*] Improvements to memory use
[*] More intuitive menu layout for gamepad users
[*] Improved main menu background graphic
[*] Fixes to repeat weapon settings
[*] Minor fixes to player animation 
[*] System performance score shown on main menu
[/list]

notes.title: HEX.PLAN.X V1.10
notes.notes:
HEX.PLAN.X V1.10
[list]
[*] Improved introduction pages and menus.
[*] Turbo walk mode for player by pressing left stick on gamepad.
[*] Improved status map graphics including player position.
[*] Commodity and token highlights when inside pick-up range.
[*] High scores shown in-play above live scores.
[*] More helpful hints shown at more useful times.
[*] Better compass hints shown below scores near the top of the screen.
[*] Faster zoom-out when showing menus or status map.
[*] Nicer safety zone and pick up radius graphics.
[*] Easier way point navigation with gamepad.
[*] Improvements to targeting of main enemies.
[*] Engine threading and caching improvements.
[*] Improved shooting graphics.
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Minor Update April 29th 2024
notes.notes:
HPX V1.09
[list]
[*] New contextual hint text and compass graphics at bottom of screen during game
[*] Second instructions page that's more gameplay focused
[*] Some character set graphics improvements to icons and numbers
[*] Set options for very low performance hardware in case of system check bypass
[/list]
